description: Dynamic search filtering switches for job discovery waves

switch_metadata.cadence_rule: Turn ON after every 5 waves (or toggle per wave as requested by user)

exclude_companies_with_existing_openings.description: Strictly exclude employers that already have one or more job openings recorded in past waves or the preceding wave. Only discover and add completely new companies.

exclude_python_heavy_roles.description: Strictly exclude Python-heavy roles (e.g. Python Developer, Quantitative Developer requiring pure Python, or roles whose primary tech stack is Python without candidate core skills like C#/.NET Core, Node.js, TypeScript, Azure, or Java).
